experiment_config_status: FROZEN: design-intent targets and weights, pseudo-Huber capped-scale loss, run-level primary metric, fixed_default, shared boss, collection mixtures, gates, split seeds, action-support limits and the 3-combat-room loot horizon are fixed for the principal collection (see experiment_freeze.json). Do not modify after collection starts.

fixed_default.name: fixed_default
fixed_default.provenance: Canonical static configuration: neutral multipliers 1.0 (enemies use the documented base constants ENEMY_BASE_HP=30, ENEMY_BASE_DMG=6, ENEMY_SPEED=110) and spawn_count = DDA_SPAWN_BASE = 2, the documented base spawn count. A consistent historical static configuration for the current game could not be established: the ALPHA build (14bab89) used multipliers 1.0 with spawn_count 6 but different base stats (ENEMY_BASE_HP=42, ENEMY_BASE_DMG=9), and 301bf81 used ad-hoc test values (0.4/0.3/0.25/2). Not tuned on pilot outcomes.

shared_boss.description: Deterministic boss policy shared by every experimental condition. The raw action below passes through dda_core.effective_applied_config (hp x4, dmg x1.7, speed x0.9, one boss). No enemy model is invoked in boss rooms.

principal_collection.description: Documented collection mixtures (per-run assignment by seeded draw). learned_loot is never used during collection; it may be trained afterwards only if the predefined Q_loot gate passes on the principal data.

loot_gate.description: Learned loot is trained only if a reward-aware Q_loot beats its information-matched state-only twin (x+c vs x, x+c+item+prior vs x+prior) on held-out runs by a MEAN aggregate-skill gain >= min_reward_gain_rel with a positive gain on EVERY grouped split in split_seeds, and beats the naive predictor on every split.
